about: What a person in this world may want, when it applies to them, what it costs (an item of the price book, or weeks of living) and why. Conditions and weights are Design proposals. The words in chances are how a concrete offer reaches the protagonist: {carrier} someone he knows, {business} and {place} from the save, {price} the asking figure, {days} how long it stands. `comes` is how many chances a week a want of full strength draws for someone of ordinary reach, `contest` the weekly odds somebody else gets there, `lasts_days` how long having it quiets the want, `gives` what having it shows of a person. `others` is how everybody else takes chances: only for a want at or above the threshold, looked at once in `every_weeks`.
